stemMarkdown: A boat travels downstream at 14 km/h and upstream at 10 km/h. Find the speed (in km/h) of the boat in still water.
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed is boat $+$ stream and upstream is boat $-$ stream. Adding the two cancels the stream: boat speed $= \dfrac{14 + 10}{2} = 12$ km/h.
altSolutionMarkdown: Subtracting instead gives the stream speed: $\dfrac{14 - 10}{2} = 2$ km/h.
